title: Systems restored
body: Database damage fixed. Systems back online. Could not restore all data. Missing: Captains log, Ship log, News, Messages, Votes, Science database prior to 131.542, 70% of the Hand Scanner (Hansca) database. Still assessing data.

title: Systems restored
body: Could not restore Captains log.

title: Starcaller Arrives and "Comes Out Swinging"
body:
Pax here, your esteemed blogger of Pax's Principles, where I report the TRUTHS, the HARD TRUTHS.

Today's hard truth is one I just stumbled upon during a routine interview: the Starcaller has been picked up, just like my former ship Orion, but man did they "come out swinging!!" That's according to a report by Gale Chapman, a marine stationed as security at the entrance of the Odysseus's hangar bay. "You're not supposed to be here," Chapman reports the security detail emerging from the ship as having had said.

Hoo boy! I thought enemies were the MACHINES not regular fellow humans like us. Is this totally unhinged, or what?! What is in that Starcaller??

Anyway, quartermaster Isha Hayakawa has a much more mundane take on the matter: "They were following standard marine procedure there."

What do you think is inside that ship anyway?? We'll keep looking for the TRUTH.

title: Message of hope
body:
Fellow survivors, it has come time to start thinking about lifting the martial law and to do that we need a functioning senate. I believe in full, that we will catch up to the rest of the fleet and find other surviving senators. We do not know as of this moment how many survivors we have. We need at least 20 senators for a functioning senate. 
I strongly encourage you to consider running for senator! I also encourage any Purple Party members thinking about doing so to come and talk to me. 
With a survivors heart
Yuri Mills - senator and leader of the Purple Party.

title: Distress signal from Solaris 7
body:
A few minutes ago, a message has been intercepted.
It seemed to come from Space Station Solaris 7.
If the message is to be trusted, there´s someone on board Solaris 7 and they ask to be rescued.

title: Two Survivors Recovered From Solaris 7; Condition Unknown
body: TRUTHS, HARD TRUTHS. Medics were rushed down to hangar bay to deal with 2 survivors that the marines recovered. WTF am I now just reporting the news?? Their condition appears to be unknown but stable.

title: Theft of Artfacts
body: The Marines are currently conducting shipwide search for two of the alien artefacts retrieved from the ESS Odysseus' most recent mission, which have been stolen from the Hive

title: Sabotage
body: There have been allegations of sabotage of the ESS Starcaller by some person or persons on board. Apparently, the engine drive failed, the jump drive failed and the beam weapons. The civilian politicians on board suspect the marines, but have no proof as far as I can ascertain.

title: Drinking on Duty
body: I have had cause to reprimand one of the pilots, Cavalry, for drinking on duty. I therefore recommend keeping an eye on their performance.

title: Let the wisdom light your way
body:
Tomorrow 9:30 am: Public service in the name of The Faith of the High Science to honor the dead and strengthen the living at the Faith*s shrine in the Science laboratory

Anytime: Get advice and solace by our High Priests Jonah Malone and Yera Romero. Talk to them whenever you feel the need.

title: Theft of Artefacts
body: I am pleased to report that Lt Abrankowich and the marines recovered all of the missing artefacts during the course of their search of the ship.

title: Velian rescue
body: We made contact with Atlantis and Velian survivors on the surface of the planet. Made second jump with experimental technology to retrieve survivors. Large swarm of hostiles at first jump, engaged and made our escape successfully. System malfunction on 3 stations on bridge confirmed by EVA to be due to cascading system failure due to old systems. EVA is patching the software to avoid further failure. No foul play.

title: Hacking Attempt
body: Admiral Allen has reported to me that an attempt was made by a person or persons unknown to hack the ship's systems earlier. No further information is available at this time.

title: Jump to Velian complete, retrieving survivors
body: We have made a jump into the Ermina system, and we are currently orbiting the planet Velian. We have several survivors who are taking refuge in the remains of the GSS Darwin planetside. Our shuttles are currently retrieving all survivors on a rescue mission. No enemies in sight currently.

title: Drinking on Duty
body: I have had cause to reprimand pilots Nike and Sweet for drinking on duty. In the light of previous infractions by pilot personnel, I am becoming increasingly concerned about the conduct of personnel from that field. I will raise the matter further with Control.

title: Guardian on board
body: The Velian Guardian, their spiritual leader, is on board. We rescued 29 souls from the planet. We believe to have a Beacon on board, retrieved from the wreck of the Genesis Ship. Science is currently decrypting jump coordinates from the Beacon.

title: GREETINGS FROM THE FLEET TO ESS ODYSSEUS
body:
OSS Odysseus, it is very nice to see you. In these unprecedented and sorrowful times, every new ship added to the fleet, every new spark of life added to the count of what remains of humanity, brings us all more hope. Welcome into the EOC Fleet. We are synching our databases with yours.

On behalf of the EOC Fleet, Fleet Secretary Tory Zarek

title: ATTACK AGAINST EOC
body:
The last few days have been hard for us all. The Machines have returned with a massive surprise attack against humanity. To the best of our knowledge, all populated areas on Ellarion, Calelena and Osiris have been destroyed in Machine bombings and ensuing fires. It is estimated that there are no survivors on the planet and its two moons. We who have managed to escape are the sole survivors of the human race. We mourn our dead and all we have lost, but we will not fall into despair. Together, we will survive.

*-Ellarion City News, Year 542 (5 days ago)*

title: Contact with Fleet
body: We have made contact and rejoined Fleet at 00:40.

title: Incoming unknowns
body: Incoming unknowns in 9 minutes.
